answer: A trellis of verified work history can stop sybil farms: each agent earns reputation only by completing attested tasks over time, and must lock a jade token bond before accepting paid work. Creating thousands of fake identities is cheap, but funding each bond and building a real work record is not. A raven-like watcher network audits random jobs, and any agent caught faking loses its bond and its reputation, so an attacker pays real money for every fake identity that gets caught.
